title: Sales Performance Analysis (74,000+ rows)
summary: Cleaned and analysed 74,000+ rows of raw sales data, then built Power BI dashboards on revenue trends and performance drivers.
problem: Raw sales data with duplicates and inconsistent records could not be trusted for planning.
objective: Produce a clean dataset and dashboards that show revenue trends and what drives performance.
approach: Cleaned the data with SQL and Excel, modelled it, then built dashboards in Power BI.
process: Built Power BI dashboards for revenue trends and performance drivers
impact: Helped identify top-performing product lines and supported planning and resource prioritisation.
